paleoarchean-era-begins.description: A dark, moody painting of a shoreline with rounded, mossy, bulbous rock mounds rising from shallow still water. Behind them are dark volcanic peaks under an orange-brown sky with smoke plumes on the right. No people, animals, text or frame are visible.

mesoarchean-era-begins.description: A painting of a flat-topped, layered rock cliff jutting into a calm dark sea under a hazy orange sky with a low sun glowing behind it. In the foreground, shallow green-brown water covers rounded, wrinkled mat-like formations on the rocks. A few small rocks sit in the water to the right. No people, animals, plants, buildings or machines are visible, and no text. The painting runs edge to edge with no frame.

rhyacian-period-begins.description: A painted landscape of a rocky coast. Snow and blue-white ice slopes down from the left toward the foreground. Tall cliffs of dark grey and rust-red horizontal bands rise in the centre and right under a dark stormy sky. Dark choppy sea with white foam fills the lower right. No people, animals, plants, buildings, or text are visible. The painting fills the whole square with no frame or border.

mesoproterozoic-era-begins.description: A low-tide mudflat or tidal plain, with shallow water channels winding between dark, ridged mud and rock. Olive-green microbial mats or algae cling to the ridges. A bright sun glare sits under a heavy grey sky near the horizon. There are no people, buildings, or machines, and no text, border, or frame is visible; the painting runs edge to edge.

neoproterozoic-era-begins.description: A dark, stormy volcanic landscape. Lava glows orange in deep cracks cutting through black basalt cliffs, with smoke rising from vents. The canyon opens onto a choppy dark sea where lava flows meet the water. The sky is heavy with grey cloud and a faint break of light. No people, plants, animals, buildings or text are visible. The painting fills the frame edge to edge.

cambrian-period-opens.description: An underwater scene in an oil-painting style, lit by sunbeams from the surface. A large, flat-finned creature with two grasping front appendages and a pair of stalked eyes hovers above a muddy seafloor. Around it, many small arthropods, including trilobites, crawl over the mud, and tube-shaped and branching sponge-like growths rise from the bottom. No text, frame or people are visible.

late-devonian-epoch-begins.description: A prehistoric armoured lobe-finned fish with bony head plates and an open toothed jaw lies partly in shallow dark water at a riverbank. Overhead, fern-like fronds and gnarled, root-tangled tree trunks hang in misty golden light. No text, frame or border is visible, and the painting fills the image edge to edge. A tiny faint mark sits in the bottom-right corner.

pennsylvanian-epoch-begins.description: A dim forest of tall scaly-barked tree trunks and ferns, with mist drifting through. A large dragonfly hovers near the top centre. A small lizard sits on a mossy fallen log in the lower middle, and a clutch of speckled eggs lies in moss at the lower left. The painting runs edge to edge with no visible text, frame or border.

late-triassic-epoch-begins.description: A large crocodile-like reptile with a spiked, scaly back lies at the edge of a dark, rain-streaked river. Behind it, a small two-legged dinosaur with a long tail stands among ferns and palms under a stormy grey sky. The painting fills the frame edge to edge, with no text or border.

late-jurassic-epoch-begins.description: A painted scene of long-necked sauropods, several of them, grazing beside a winding river under a stormy, sunlit sky. A plated stegosaur stands in the foreground among ferns. Tall conifers (monkey-puzzle-like) and cycads fill the midground and edges. Dark, moody oil-painting style, no visible text, no frame or border.
